title: Solution Structure of the Novel CH-domain zinc finger from the puberty regulator Makorin-3
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR解析MKRN3 CH结构域锌指结构，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关锌指折叠，但核心为蛋白结构表征，未聚焦TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法，仅AlphaFold建模辅助，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: The makorin (MKRN) family of E3 ubiquitin ligases (MKRN1–4) regulates diverse biological processes, including reproduction, neurogenesis, and immune function. The first identified member, MKRN3, is an inhibitor of sexual development that is the site of inherited mutations linked to central precocious puberty (CPP). All makorin proteins share a distinctive cysteine/histidine-rich (CH) domain that has not been previously characterized experimentally. In MKRN3, the CH domain lies between the second C3H zinc finger and the RING domain. The C3H(2)–CH–RING segment appears particularly sensitive to CPP mutations suggesting it may constitute a structure-function unit. Using CD and NMR spectroscopy, we show that the CH domain folds upon coordination of a single Zn 2+ ion with picomolar affinity. Spectroscopic and NMR pH-titration analyses identify a CCHC-type metal-binding site, typical of zinc fingers with protein-interaction functions. The NMR structure reveals the CH-domain adopts a canonical ββα zinc finger fold, despite atypical ligand spacing and the absence of conserved hydrophobic residues that usually stabilize this type of motif. Thermal denaturation monitored by multiple spectroscopic probes indicates sequential unfolding, with side-chain packing disrupted near 33 °C but zinc-stabilized secondary structure persisting to ∼63 °C, consistent with a molten-globule intermediate at high temperature. The function of the CH-domain remains unknown, but it could play a role in allosterically transmitting information on the RNA-bound state of the preceding C3H(2) domain to the subsequent RING domain. Based on a similar metal ligand spacing to a zinc finger from the protein FAAP20 and AlphaFold modeling, the CH-domain may have a ubiquitin-binding function, but this will need to be verified experimentally as AlphaFold also confidently predicts complexes with unrelated random proteins.
abstract_zh: makorin (MKRN) 家族E3泛素连接酶（MKRN1–4）调控多种生物学过程，包括生殖、神经发生和免疫功能。首个被鉴定的成员MKRN3是性发育的抑制剂，其遗传突变与中枢性性早熟（CPP）相关。所有makorin蛋白共享一个独特的富含半胱氨酸/组氨酸（CH）结构域，该结构域此前未被实验表征。在MKRN3中，CH结构域位于第二个C3H锌指和RING结构域之间。C3H(2)–CH–RING片段对CPP突变尤为敏感，提示其可能构成一个结构-功能单元。利用圆二色（CD）和核磁共振（NMR）波谱学，我们证明CH结构域在配位单个Zn²⁺离子（亲和力为皮摩尔级）时折叠。波谱学和NMR pH滴定分析鉴定出一个CCHC型金属结合位点，这是典型具有蛋白质相互作用功能的锌指特征。NMR结构揭示CH结构域采用典型的ββα锌指折叠，尽管配体间距异常且缺乏通常稳定此类基序的保守疏水残基。通过多种波谱探针监测的热变性表明其发生顺序解折叠，侧链堆积在约33 °C时被破坏，而锌稳定的二级结构持续至约63 °C，与高温下的熔球中间态一致。CH结构域的功能仍未知，但它可能在变构传递前一个C3H(2)结构域的RNA结合状态信息至后续RING结构域中发挥作用。基于与蛋白质FAAP20中锌指相似的金属配体间距及AlphaFold建模，CH结构域可能具有泛素结合功能，但这需实验验证，因为AlphaFold也自信地预测了与无关随机蛋白质的复合物。
